t: The Magnusson aluminium combination ladder is a high-performance access solution, offering improved stability and slip-resistance for a wide range of trade applications. This versatile ladder is ideal for various professional tasks, from electricians working at height to general builders needing flexible access on site. It functions as both a stepladder and an extension ladder, adapting to different working height requirements. With a robust 150kg static vertical load capacity and a maximum open height of 1.58m, it is built for professional use. The included 805mm fixed stabiliser bar and non-slip feet and rungs ensure secure footing and safety during operation.
